"""Build rounded tables and a fixed native gallery from completed evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V170-nonlocal-raw-v2'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V168-EMA','V169-EMA','NLRaw-Malvar','NLRaw-DINO'];columns=['V143 parent','V168 EMA','V169 EMA','NLRaw Malvar','NLRaw DINO hybrid']
text='# V170 released learned RAW matching comparison

'+notes.read_text().strip()+'

'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json) · [Native pixel,checkpoint,noise and display metadata](images/v170-nonlocal-raw-v1/manifest-v1.json).

'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'

| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |
| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |
'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'
'
 text+='
'
table('Mesh and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside edges',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native512 standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
text+='All RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Signed template gain1 means the constructed mesh amplitude;a small signed absent mean does not establish absence of artifacts. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. Means/counts and every paired difference are retained,without significance or blind-generalization claims.

'
text+='## External checkpoint and implementation

'
text+='The [April2026 NLFeMF paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17453) describes learned matching and filtering on noise-conditioned RAW. This comparison uses the [official v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/MIA-UIB/nonlocal-matchfilter/releases/tag/v1.0.0),commit `6df6a79ce128a7741af88ff0f3e9794f9b5e03d4`. Its external RAW training data differ from our freely licensed image pipeline. This is a pipeline comparison,not an isolated architecture or training test;training media were not downloaded,and no blind split equivalence or training-image license equivalence is claimed.

'
text+='The selected seven original class definitions match upstream ASTs exactly. All141 tensors/15,282,866 parameters load strictly. The pinned deform-neighbourhood v0.1.1 CPU/CUDA sampler is built for GB10 without changing its interpolation. Four independent NumPy sampler fixtures match CPU/CUDA. Original and copied full networks are bit-identical on CPU;CUDA parity differs by at most2.24e-8 normalized. This admission used two CPU and one CUDA full-model calls,separate from quality. All13 independent Bayer/conditioning/consistency CPU tests pass. MIT notices and embedded Caffe notices remain in the source evidence.

'
text+='The frontend flips native Bayer geometry to RGGB and uses RGBG channel order. It supplies noisy RAW clipped0..1 plus the square root of the inherited noisy-input variance. Output RAW clips0..1 as in upstream evaluation. Targets and references never enter inference. One neural call provides two fixed outputs:`Malvar(denoised RAW)`;and `V143 parent + Malvar(denoised RAW - CFA(parent))`. The second retains the DINO parent's interpolation residual while changing measured sensor samples to the RAW estimate,up to FP32 rounding. Signed residuals/final RGB are not clipped. Neither return is a calibrated detail detector.

'
text+='Original checkpoint SHA256 `b31bc8e21022389b0b209a9d1e6649485ed4dacc552b7ea04612df5f7515fcf2`;tensor-only checkpoint SHA256 `a891235b053ef00072d411d53feba65120ffe903f15bee32b5017fd39e700b51`. The restricted extraction substitutes inert classes for unused OmegaConf metadata rather than executing checkpoint code. All91 previous neural source files remain unchanged.

'
text+='## Work and audit scope

'
audit=read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')
text+=f"All822 cached cases completed once:822 actual quality neural roots,with4110 nested learned-sampling calls. Outer wrapper and nested network counts describe the same822 calls. The two RGB returns give1644 streamed metric rows. Admission adds one discarded synthetic CUDA full-model call and two CPU calls;total new CUDA full-model calls are823. No new source/noise,training,parent/DINO or original/dataz reads occurred. Both recorded worker owners are terminal.

"
text+=f"All822 event/input/parent bindings,3288 actual input fingerprints and1644 durable RGB rows are audited. Full arrays are retained only for36 preselected native cases:72 RGB plus36 RAW arrays,250,951,168 bytes. Independent saved-array metrics check {audit['scalar_checks']} scalar values. NumPy64 independently reconstructs {audit['independent_NumPy_reconstructed_channels']:,} RGB channels from those RAW outputs and parents;maximum discrepancy is {audit['maximum_reconstruction_error_DN16']:.6f} DN16. Other new outputs were scored/fingerprinted and RMS-norm/decomposition checked in process;there is no complete new full-array archive or all822 new-array posthoc audit. Independent Decimal means check {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} reductions.

"
text+='Peak quality CUDA allocation is2.420598GiB. Recorded wrapper-forward intervals total210.214s,median.278519s across mixed128–768 native contexts,including two Malvar returns and excluding disk/metric work. These intervals are not a matched whole-pipeline/full-frame speed benchmark;the hybrid also depends on a cached DINO parent. No100MP inference or10-second claim is made.

'
text+='A new bounded-trial policy reserved52GiB local/114GiB external plus.5GiB projection margin,32GiB runtime RAM and12GiB CUDA;old studies' guards remain unchanged. Shape-metadata preparation failure and a missing-helper initialization failure are preserved with exact source/log evidence. Both preceded held-out inference. The verified helper was added through a separate prelaunch receipt,without changing the frozen inference AST/plan. No completed scientific forward repeated. [Original protocol](results/v170-nonlocal-raw-v1/original-protocol-v1.md) · [Preparation](results/v170-nonlocal-raw-preparation-v1.json) · [Dependency correction](results/v170-runtime-dependency-preparation-v1.json).

'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons

'
text+='Every cell is160×160 native pixels without resizing. The48 boards and12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets preserve V169 coordinates,noise,transform,exposure,anchor and contrast. All60 figures were actually viewed in15 original-detail sheets. Source/ROI,CFA,noise conditioning,checkpoint hash and display exposure are bound in the manifest. The synthetic mesh uses RGGB512,ROI `[176,176,160,160]`,shot.00128/read variance6.5536e-6,exposure8,contrast1/40. Quiet fields useROI `[80,176,160,160]`,exposure8,contrast40;native flats useROI `[176,176,160,160]`,exposure4,contrast40. ISO12800 uses shot.00256/read variance2.62144e-5. Per-case anchors and camera transforms are in the manifest. Photographic credits/licenses remain in the [V168 source report](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).

'
text+='The standing main DSCF3879 ISO6400/DSCF3880 ISO100 scene includes sky,building,foliage and chain-link fence at exposure4. Cab DSCF3842/DSCF3835 includes both noise priors,two160px windows `[206,229,160,160]`/`[426,189,160,160]` in768px contexts,exposure16,and both camera JPEGs. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture,shutter,motion and processing;they are qualitative references,not exact GT,and are not pixelwise scored. Captures/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded from training and original files read-only. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).

'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy,restored,exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'

'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  name=Path(item['image']['path']).name;text+=f"{item['case']['id']};ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`,exposure{item['exposure']:g},contrast{item['contrast']:g}.

![Native comparison](images/v170-nonlocal-raw-v1/{name})

"
text+='## Reproducing dependency preparation

```bash
source scripts/env.sh
uv sync --extra nonlocal
PYTHONPATH=src:scripts .venv/bin/python scripts/fetch_nonlocal_raw.py
```

The optional comparison uses separately downloaded released weights and a local native kernel build. It is not selected by ordinary inference. [Independent publication verification](results/v170-nonlocal-raw-publication-verification-v1.json).
'
target=repo/'docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md';target.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-actual-notes-paired-tables-and-native-viewing',report=ref(target),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built',len(cells),'rounded table cells and60 native figures')

"""Preserve published v1 bytes while improving prose and optional-test integration."""
import difflib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V170-nonlocal-raw-v2';dest=repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-v1'
receipt=dest/'integration-and-editorial-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
oldreport=repo/'docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md';previous=dest/'report-original-v1.md';assert not previous.exists();previous.write_bytes(oldreport.read_bytes())
assert ref(previous)['sha256']==read(repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json')['report']['sha256']
words='All|all|Both|both|The|the|from|versus|for|in|and|of|only|is|are|uses|with|clipped|gain|at|to|rises|falls|total|median|mixed|reserved|reserves|arrays|calls|means|includes|exposure|contrast|shot|variance|radius|sigma|plus|No|no|group|unit|case|step|useROI|Native|native'
def plain(s):
 s=re.sub(r'(?<=[,;])(?=[A-Za-z])',' ',s)
 s=re.sub(r'(?<=[A-Za-z]),(?=[0-9])',', ',s)
 s=re.sub(r':(?=[0-9])',': ',s)
 s=re.sub(r'\b('+words+r')(?=\d|\.\d)',r'\1 ',s)
 s=s.replace("EMA's3.837", "EMA's 3.837")
 s=re.sub(r'(?<=\d)(GiB|DN16|px|MP|s)\b',r' \1',s)
 s=re.sub(r'\b(plus|median|shot|variance)\.(?=\d)',r'\1 0.',s)
 s=s.replace('0..1','[0, 1]').replace('useROI','use ROI').replace('NumPy64','NumPy64')
 return s

def line(s):
 if s.lstrip().startswith(('|','```','![Native comparison]')):return s
 # Keep case identifiers and Markdown destinations/code literals unchanged.
 start=''
 if ';ROI ' in s:start,s=s.split(';ROI ',1);start+='; ROI '
 parts=re.split(r'(`[^`]*`|\]\([^)]*\))',s)
 return start+''.join(p if p.startswith(('`','](')) else plain(p) for p in parts)

documents=['README.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/index.md','docs/research.md','docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md','diary/2026-11-07-14-11-16-v170-nonlocal-raw-results.md']
changes={}
for name in documents:
 p=repo/name;before=p.read_text();lines=before.splitlines(keepends=True)
 if name in ['docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md',documents[-1]]:
  after=''.join(map(line,lines))
 else:
  original=subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:'+name],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines(keepends=True)
  after=''
  for tag,i,j,k,l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=original,b=lines,autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
   after+=''.join(map(line,lines[k:l])) if tag in ['insert','replace'] else ''.join(lines[k:l])
 if before!=after:
  before_binding=ref(p);p.write_text(after);changes[name]=dict(before=before_binding,before_text=before,after=ref(p))
# Current human links point to the version that binds current report prose.
for name in ['docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md',documents[-1]]:
 p=repo/name;text=p.read_text().replace('v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json','v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v2.json').replace('v170-nonlocal-raw-publication-verification-v1.json','v170-nonlocal-raw-publication-verification-v2.json');p.write_text(text)
 if name in changes:changes[name]['after']=ref(p)
 else:raise AssertionError('Expected prose change')
# Original metric cells,figures,protocol,journals and receipts remain unchanged.
bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v1.json');assert all(v in oldreport.read_text() for v in bindings['lines'])
save(root/'report-bindings-v2.json',dict(bindings,report=ref(oldreport),previous_bindings=ref(root/'report-bindings-v1.json'),preserved_original_report=ref(previous),editorial_source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
installed=repo/'.cache/v170-optional-installed-tests-v1.log';absent=repo/'.cache/v170-optional-absent-tests-v1.log'
assert '13 passed' in installed.read_text() and '9 passed, 4 skipped' in absent.read_text()
assert 'pytest.importorskip("einops"' in (repo/'tests/test_nonlocal_raw.py').read_text()
save(receipt,dict(status='optional-dependency-tests-and-editorial-only-after-completed-quality',previous_publication=ref(repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json'),preserved_original_report=ref(previous),report_bindings=ref(root/'report-bindings-v2.json'),changes=changes,
 optional_installed_tests=dict(ref(installed),text=installed.read_text()),optional_absent_tests=dict(ref(absent),text=absent.read_text()),current_test=dict(ref(repo/'tests/test_nonlocal_raw.py'),text=(repo/'tests/test_nonlocal_raw.py').read_text()),
 sources=[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in [Path(__file__),repo/'.cache/v170-optional-tests-v1.py',repo/'.cache/verify-v170-publication-v2.py']],new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,new_training_updates=0,
 scope='Current test adds an importorskip only for the4 network-construction/stub cases;9 independent Bayer checks still execute without einops. All13 pass with the optional extra. No inference sources,weights,quality outputs,metric cells or machine-receipt bytes change. Original published report preserved byte-exact. Prose spacing and current evidence links only change in human documents.'))
old=read(repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json')
save(repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v2.json',dict(old,report=ref(oldreport),previous_publication=ref(repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v1.json'),integration=ref(receipt),report_bindings=ref(root/'report-bindings-v2.json'),preserved_original_report=ref(previous)))
print('Prepared current publication v2;original v1 report/receipts preserved;13 installed/9 absent+4skipped CPU checks')
